$comment: One entry per id OSV returns and component it returns it for, read by
scripts/vuln-watch.mjs, which fails on an id with no entry here, or one
triaged for another component, version or severity, or rated below the
CVE record with no `rating_note`; on an open entry past its due date; and
on an entry whose id OSV no longer returns, until it is taken out
(SECURITY.md, "Vulnerabilities in what the installers carry"). These are
OSV matches read against how this app uses each component, not
vulnerabilities found in it.
`osv_severity` is what OSV gives, as it gives it: the newest CVSS vector,
else the database's own rating, else null. `severity` is the highest
rating a CVE record of the id or its aliases gives that vector, its CNA's
or an ADP's; where OSV gives none (the PSF's own ids), the highest any of
them gives, and "unrated" only for an id with no CVE alias. `rating_note`,
needed where `severity` is below that rating or nothing rates the id (a
vector no record names, an alias with no record or no score), says how
the entry was rated instead.
Verdicts: `not-affected`, the affected code is not in what ships (not
compiled, not linked, not bundled); `not-reachable`, it ships but nothing
the app runs reaches it in the way the advisory needs; `fixed-in-pin`, the
pinned version already carries the fix and OSV's match is stale; `open`,
it is reachable, or not yet shown not to be, and is due by `due`: 14 days
from `triaged` for critical or high, 60 for anything else.

entries.reason: The flaw is in libavformat/tls_mbedtls.c, and the pinned build has no TLS at all: it is configured --disable-network --disable-autodetect with only the file and pipe protocols, and the proof refuses a binary whose configuration differs (ADR-040).
The flaw is in the libssh sftp protocol, which the pinned build does not compile: it enables only the file and pipe protocols, links no libssh and is configured --disable-network (ADR-040).

av_dynamic_hdr_plus_to_t35 writes HDR10+ metadata out, so what reaches it is an encoder or a muxer, and its only callers in FFmpeg's sources are the Matroska muxer and the libaom AV1 encoder (both at n9.0.1 too), neither of which the pinned build compiles: its muxers are mp4, gif, image2 and rawvideo, and its one external encoder is libx264. The function ships in libavutil, but nothing in the build calls it, and the frames the app hands ffmpeg are its own PNG or JPEG captures, which carry no HDR10+ side data.
The loop is in the DASH demuxer, which the pinned build does not compile: its demuxers are image2, mov and gif alone (ADR-040).

The mov demuxer that builds the pssh list is compiled in, but on the app's path ffmpeg reads only the PNG or JPEG frames the app captured, a palette the engine wrote and silent audio from lavfi. The one engine call that opens an MP4, export.poster for a contact sheet, is not reachable from schematic.serve, the only entry the app runs.
The loop is in RTSP, which the pinned build does not compile: it is configured --disable-network with only the file and pipe protocols and has no RTSP demuxer (ADR-040).

The overflow is in gz_write, after a failed write through gzwrite. Nothing that carries zlib 1.3.2 writes through the gz* file API: CPython on Windows compiles none of zlib's gz*.c files (PCbuild/pythoncore.vcxproj at v3.12.14), FFmpeg calls only deflate, inflate and uncompress, and LOOM only gzread (util::zreadAll at the pinned commit; the macOS builds of both import nothing else from libz).

The overflow is in gz_vacate, reached through gzprintf after a stalled gzwrite. Nothing that carries zlib 1.3.2 writes through the gz* file API: CPython on Windows compiles none of zlib's gz*.c files (PCbuild/pythoncore.vcxproj at v3.12.14), FFmpeg calls only deflate, inflate and uncompress, and LOOM only gzread (util::zreadAll at the pinned commit; the macOS builds of both import nothing else from libz).
